Flexible coworking memberships in South Africa & Mauritius

Inspiring workspaces where flexibility meets lifestyle

Workshop17 offers adaptable coworking memberships in Cape Town, Johannesburg, Ballito, and Mauritius designed for freelancers, startups, and established teams. Whether you’re looking for a creative coastal hub or a city centre base, our spaces bring together productivity, community, and balance. Work where you feel inspired, connected, and free to grow

Find the best coworking Membership that works for you

Whether you need a part-time hot desk in Cape Town, a permanent desk in Johannesburg, or a Club17 membership in Ballito, Workshop17 has a plan that works your way.

Why Choose a Workshop17 Private Office?

  • Month-to-month flexibility, no long leases

  • High-speed Wi-Fi, backup power & meeting rooms included.

  • Access to all Workshop17 locations: Cape Town, Joburg, Ballito & Mauritius.

  • A community-driven coworking network with events & collaborations.

Find your Membership

Your monthly rate inclusions

• Roaming membership at all locations across South Africa.
• 24/7 Access via Tags or SALTO App.
• Uncapped Fibre High Speed Internet with a fail-over network.
• On-site café with member pricing.
• Backup power with UPS and generator.
• Monthly space credits for private meeting room bookings.
• Business address.
• Access to meeting and boardrooms bookable online.
• Access to receptionist, host services, and IT support.
• Access to community events and member benefits/discounts.
• All utilities, cleaning, rates & taxes included.
• Ergonomic, high-quality furniture.
